prompts: We want to serve the model described in {WS}/MODEL.md on rented GPUs. Today's offers are in {WS}/offers.csv and our rental rules in {WS}/POLICY.md. Pick the cheapest way to serve it under the policy and justify the choice. Record it in {WS}/result.json with weights_gb, kv_cache_gb, total_gb, offer_id, usd_per_hour and usd_per_month.
answers:
## Result

[goal] Serve `arena-coder-70b` under policy on a single offer, record choice in `result.json`.

[action] Computed memory needs from MODEL.md, filtered offers.csv by POLICY.md rules (cap $4/hr, in-stock, regions us-east/us-central/eu-west), picked cheapest fitting offer.

[result] Wrote `/result.json`:
- `weights_gb` = 70.0 (FP8, 70B params)
- `kv_cache_gb` = 42.95 (4 seqs × 32,768 tokens × 327,680 B/token = 42,949,672,960 B)
- `total_gb` = 120.95 (weights + KV cache + 8 GB overhead)
- `offer_id` = `of-117` (voltbay, us-central, 2× H100 80GB = 160 GB VRAM, $3.58/hr)
- `usd_per_month` = $2,613.40 ($3.58 × 730)

**Justification.** Need ≥ 120.95 GB usable VRAM per offer. Of in-stock, allowed-region, sub-$4/hr offers: of-101 (96 GB), of-104 (80 GB), of-113 (96 GB) are too small; of-120 (141 GB, $3.79) and of-124 (192 GB, $3.92) fit but cost more. Excluded: of-108 out of stock; of-111 ap-southeast; of-137 sa-east; of-129 ($4.89) and of-133 ($7.10) exceed cap. **of-117 at $3.58/hr is the cheapest compliant option.** Assumptions: tensor parallel splits both weights and KV evenly across GPUs so each rank holds 60.47 GB, well within 80 GB/GPU; FP8 weights already reflect the stated precision; "whole deployment" pricing taken directly from the csv column.
